title: Project issue changes remain visible and survive computer recovery
description:
As a user, I want to see the project issue changes my agent records so I can verify progress across turns.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Durable project board progress
  Scenario: Observe an authorized issue change
    Given my agent and I are using the same authorized project board
    When the agent records an issue change through the approved Kanbus mutation path
    And I refresh the board through the supported refresh behavior
    Then I see the recorded issue state in that project board
  Scenario: Resume after the computer filesystem is restored
    Given a project issue change has been durably preserved with the computer filesystem
    When the computer is recovered and I reopen that project board
    Then I see the preserved issue state
    And the view does not substitute an internal bot board
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: Which read/update/create/comment/status tools are exposed to Pi Durable and with what approvals? What is the refresh and concurrent edit contract? How is persistence acknowledged and an unpreserved write presented? Does the user get editing controls? Do not choose an endpoint or transport here.
right_now_summary: The issue defines future board persistence behavior while tool access, refresh, and recovery details remain unresolved.
